## OBIS DNA Data Management Platform

Through the eDNA Expeditions Project, OBIS is developing a data management platform for DNA data including:

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}

* Bioinformatics
* QC
* Validation
* Publication to OBIS pipeline

:::
